YouConsole: I could do that
BotConsole: Great! I’m sure that if me move around a little
BotConsole: In a rather intense way
BotConsole: Regularly
BotConsole: Your health will improve
YouConsole: I think I got the message already…
BotConsole: Very well!
BotConsole: Be sure to make some stretches beforehand
BotConsole: With such intense exercise that I have in mind, it wouldn’t be unusual for you to get a cramp!
I guess that’s enough with the flirting. Let’s jump into action.
